topic: Trusting a landlord's verbal promises vs putting every promise in a signed lease addendum (Calvin vs Augusta)

scenes.narration: If it is not in the lease, it was never promised. Court is in session!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera at the bench holding a lease with a blank line, a speech bubble fading away, comic burst banner reads NOT IN WRITING, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Calvin and Augusta both tour the same apartment building in May.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man calvin and woman augusta each touring an apartment with a leasing agent, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: The agent promises free parking and new carpet before move in.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a leasing agent smiling with a speech banner reading FREE PARKING AND NEW CARPET, fingers crossed behind his back, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Calvin signs the standard lease that afternoon and shakes hands.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man calvin shaking hands and signing a standard lease, no extra pages, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Move in day, the old carpet is still there and parking is ninety dollars.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man calvin standing on a stained carpet holding a notice reading PARKING NINETY DOLLARS MONTHLY, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: He complains. Management says nothing like that is in your lease.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a manager pointing at a lease page, speech banner reads SHOW ME WHERE IT SAYS THAT, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Over the year he pays one thousand eighty dollars for parking.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a stack of parking receipts adding up to a total reading ONE THOUSAND EIGHTY, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Augusta asks for every promise in a signed addendum before she signs.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman augusta holding a pen back, speech banner reads WRITE IT INTO THE LEASE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: The addendum lists free parking and carpet replaced by June first.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a lease addendum reading FREE PARKING SPACE FOURTEEN and NEW CARPET BY JUNE FIRST, two signatures, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: When the carpet is late, she cites the addendum and gets a rent credit.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman augusta showing the addendum to a manager, a rent statement shows a credit line, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Calvin paid one thousand eighty for a promise. Augusta paid nothing.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel, man calvin feeding a parking meter, woman augusta parking free in space fourteen, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Verbal promises are worth nothing. Get an addendum signed. Court dismissed!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera banging her gavel beside a signed page reading LEASE ADDENDUM with a gold seal, kids comic book illustration
